data.title: Jobcenter change notice: Bürgergeld recalculated from November 2025
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen sent a change notice (Änderungsbescheid) dated 15 October 2025. Because heating cost advances changed, your monthly entitlement is €1,126.40 from 1 November 2025. You must submit three months of bank statements by 5 November 2025.
data.explanation: Your Bürgergeld for 1 November 2025 to 30 April 2026 was recalculated because your heating cost advances changed. You now get €1,126.40 per month. Send the bank statements for the last three months to the Jobcenter by 5 November 2025. Without them, benefits cannot continue to be granted from December. If you disagree with the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Jobcenter; the app shows the deadline. Check the calculation, and consider seeking advice if unsure.

items.title: Submit bank statements
items.action: Submit your bank statements for the last three months to the Jobcenter.
items.consequence: Without these documents, benefits cannot continue to be granted from December.
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie bis zum 05.11.2025 die Kontoauszüge der letzten drei Monate ein.

items.title: Objection (Widerspruch) window
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection against the notice, in writing or on record at the Jobcenter.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann jede betroffene Person innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erheben.
